verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              अग्नीनां विविधा वंशाः कीर्तितास्ते मयानघ। शृणु जन्म तु कौरव्य कार्तिकेयस्य धीमतः॥१॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : O sinless one, O descendant of Kuru, I have told you the history of the various branches of the Agni race. (Now) hear about the birth of the intelligent Kartikeya.
verses.bhavadeepa: कायात् कस्य प्रजापतेः पुत्रोऽङ्गिराः कायस्तस्मात् । कशब्दादण्प्रत्यये कस्येदिति इकारोन्तादेशः। णित्वादादिवृद्धिः । ज्योतिष्टोमो यथा उद्भिदादिरूपेण बहुधा निर्गतस्तद्वत् ॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: अद्भुतस्याद्भुतं पुत्रं प्रवक्ष्याम्यमितौजसम्। जातं ब्रह्मर्षिभार्याभिर्ब्रह्मण्यं कीर्तिवर्धनम्॥२॥
verses.english: I shall (now) speak to you about the wonderful and famous and highly effulgent son of Adbhut, who was born of the wives of the Brahmarsis.
verses.bhavadeepa: क्रमप्राप्तं कुमारश्च यथोत्पन्नो यथा चाग्नेः सुतोऽभवदित्यस्योत्तरमाह अग्नीनां विविधा वंशा इत्यादिना ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: देवासुराः पुरा यत्ता विनिघ्नन्तः परस्परम्। तत्राजयन् सदा देवान् दानवा घोररूपिणः॥३॥
verses.english: In the days of yore, the Devas and the Danavas were always engaged in destroying one another. The fearful Danavas were always able to vanquish the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: वध्यमानं बलं दृष्ट्वा बहुशस्तैः पुरन्दरः। स सैन्यनायकार्थाय चिन्तामाप भृशं तदा॥४॥
verses.english: Findings his armies slaughtered by them and being eager to find out a Generalissimo for the celestials army Purandara (Indra) was filled with great anxiety.

verses.sanskrit: देवसेनां दानवैर्हि भग्नां दृष्ट्वा महाबलः। पालयेद्वीर्यमाश्रित्य स ज्ञेयः पुरुषो मया॥५॥
verses.english: (He thought), "I must find out a powerful person, who will be able to reorganize the celestials army, slaughtered as it is by the Danavas."

verses.sanskrit: स शैलं मानसं गत्वा ध्यायन्नर्थमिदं भृशम्। शुश्रावार्तस्वरं घोरमथ मुक्तं स्त्रिया तदा॥६॥
verses.english: He then went to the Mandara mountain. When he was deeply engaged in his own thought, he heard a piteous voice of a woman crying.

verses.sanskrit: अभिधावतु मां कश्चित् पुरुषस्त्रातु चैव ह। पतिं च मे प्रदिशतु स्वयं वा पतिरस्तु मे॥७॥
verses.english: "May some one soon come to me. Let him point out to me a protector or become my protector himself.”

verses.sanskrit: पुरन्दरस्तु तामाह मा भैर्नास्ति भयं तव। एवमुक्त्वा ततोऽपश्यत् केशिनं स्थितमग्रतः॥८॥
verses.english: Purandara said to her, “Don't be afraid; you have no fear.” When he said this he saw Keshin (an Asura) standing before him.

verses.sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदापाणिं धातुमन्तमिवाचलम्। हस्ते गृहीत्वा कन्यां तामथैनं वासवोऽब्रवीत्॥९॥
verses.english: Like a hill of metals. He had a crown on his head and a mace in his hand, he held a lady by the hand. To him Vasava thus spoke,

verses.sanskrit: अनार्यकर्मन् कस्मात् त्वमिमां कन्यां जिहीर्षसि। वज्रिणं मां विजानीहि विरमास्याः प्रबाधनात्॥१०॥
verses.english: “Why are you insolently behaving towards this lady? Know that I am the wielder of thunder. Stop from doing any violence to this lady."

verses.sanskrit:
केश्युवाच।
              विसृजस्व त्वमेवैनां शक्रैषा प्रार्थिता मया। क्षमं ते जीवतो गन्तुं स्वपुरं पाकशासन॥११॥
verses.english: Keshin said: O chastiser of Paka, leave her alone. I desire to possess her. Do you think that you will be able to return home with your life?

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा गदां केशी चिक्षेपेन्द्रवधाय वै। तामापतन्तीं चिच्छेद मध्ये वज्रेण वासवः॥१२॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : Having said this, Keshin hurled his mace to kill Indra. When falling Vasava cut it down with his thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्य शैलशिखरं केशी क्रुद्धो व्यवासृजत्। तदा पतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य शैलशृङ्गं शतक्रतुः॥१३॥
verses.english: Thereupon Keshin in great anger hurled upon Indra a large mass of rocks. Seeing that the mass of rocks was falling (upon him) Shatakratu.

verses.sanskrit: बिभेद राजन् वज्रेण भुवि तन्निपपात ह। पतता तु तदा केशी तेन शृङ्गेण ताडितः॥१४॥
verses.english: O king, cut it down with his thunderbolt and it fell on the ground. Keshin himself was wounded by that falling mass of rocks.

verses.sanskrit: हित्वा कन्यां महाभागां प्राद्रवद्भृशपीडितः। अपयातेऽसुरे तस्मिंस्तां कन्यां वासवोऽब्रवीत्। काऽसि कस्यासि किञ्चेह कुरुषे त्वं शुभानने॥१५॥
verses.english: Having been thus wounded, he fled away leaving the damsel behind. When the Asura was gone, Indra thus spoke to the lady, “Who and whose are you? O beautiful one, what has brought you here?” CHADTCR 29A
